name: fortranbridge
description: Translates legacy FORTRAN (66/77/90/95/2003) into modern, high-performance C++ (C++17/20, Eigen, OpenMP) or vectorized scientific Python (NumPy, SciPy, Numba), with automated 0-based offset conversion, memory layout transposition, COMMON block encapsulation, and numerical equivalence verification.
